yarn-troppo.meaning: All facts survive, quotes verbatim, minerals list complete, flight specs and counties intact. Asides react to the original ("Which is government for \"it's a big one, and we've been keen on this patch for ages.\"", "The whole periodic table, near enough."), but a few add claims: "a chopper buzzing about low over your roof", "so nobody's perving in your backyard", "so no choppers at three in the morning".
yarn-troppo.sense: Most terms fit ("chucked in his two bob's worth", "sussing out where the energy, the groundwater and the natural hazards are hiding", "above board", "the whole box and dice"); "the top rock man in California" for the State Geologist is a stretch.
yarn-troppo.authenticity: A natural Australian voice for the most part: "having a red-hot go at dragging the nation’s maps ... into this century", "before anyone gets their knickers in a knot". The opener "Okay, so." and "Not a cent." are stock bolt-ons.
yarn-troppo.register: Told as a full yarn with constant asides ("Handy thing to know if you live near a volcano, ay?", "like a big mozzie's nose"), far heavier than level 3. No swearing, within vulgarity 1.
yarn-troppo.tone: The press release becomes a chatty yarn, which the brief allows, but some asides make light of the safety points: "so nobody's perving in your backyard".
yarn-troppo.flow: Lively and readable, but the asides crowd some paragraphs: "Daylight hours only, too, so no choppers at three in the morning."
yarn-troppo.variety: Varied ("squiz", "red-hot go", "two bob's worth", "chock-full", "box and dice"); "reckon" repeats: "the experts reckon", "they reckon could be down there".
yarn-troppo.essence: Still the survey announcement in shape and content, though the jokey running commentary reshapes its character: "Only the biggest tungsten producer the U.S. has ever had, that's all."

unharnessed.meaning: All facts kept, but Jones's direct quote is reworded inside the quotation marks: "Teaming up with the state surveys helps get national goals done", "The California Geological Survey is pitching in on the nation's work". Lancaster's quote is kept verbatim.
unharnessed.sense: Terms fit: "a thin slice of western Nevada", "a chunk of eastern California", "choppers", "above board under U.S. law", "sizing up the potential for geothermal energy".
unharnessed.authenticity: Natural, plain Australian news English: "There's still plenty of potential for exploring and mining in the survey areas."
unharnessed.register: A light level 3: plain retelling with modest slang ("choppers", "chunk", "pitching in", "above board"). Slightly light. No swearing.
unharnessed.tone: Keeps the informative release tone: "These scientific instruments are completely passive and give off nothing that's any risk to people, animals or plants."
unharnessed.flow: Smooth throughout: "The survey involves collecting magnetic and radiometric data from choppers flying pre-planned flight lines 660 feet (200 metres) apart".
unharnessed.variety: Modest but unrepeated slang: "thin slice", "chunk", "pitching in", "above board", "sizing up".
unharnessed.essence: Unmistakably the original release: "Flights will be based out of the Bishop and Lone Pine airports".

yarn-dinkum.meaning: Every fact is kept and both quotes stay verbatim; additions are colour hung off the original: "Keep an eye on the sky", "Don't stress:".
yarn-dinkum.sense: Terms fit: "suss out where the energy, the groundwater and the natural hazards are", "country that's chock-full of all sorts of mineral deposits", "a fair bit left to find and dig up", "above board".
yarn-dinkum.authenticity: Sounds like an Australian reporter: "It's a team effort between", "the USGS's push to drag the nation’s maps of geology and mineral resources up to date".
yarn-dinkum.register: Right on level 3: a steady, natural sprinkle without turning the release into a pub yarn. No swearing.
yarn-dinkum.tone: Informative and reassuring, as the original: "Don't stress: the scientific instruments are totally passive".
yarn-dinkum.flow: Reads like it was written that way: "Think the Pine Creek mine near Bishop, Calif., the biggest tungsten producer the U.S. has ever had."
yarn-dinkum.variety: Varied: "Keep an eye on the sky", "team effort", "suss out", "chock-full", "Think the", "Don't stress", "above board".
yarn-dinkum.essence: Unmistakably the original release, retold: "Everything they collect goes up free for anyone on the USGS ScienceBase website."

yarn-deadset.meaning: Everything kept, quotes verbatim: "The survey areas still have heaps of exploration and production potential."
yarn-deadset.sense: The few swaps fit ("kick off", "a push to bring the nation’s maps ... up to date", "pin down", "choppers"); "the groundwork geological data" strains for "foundational".
yarn-deadset.authenticity: What Aussie there is sounds natural ("heaps of exploration and production potential", "a chunk of eastern California"), but much is the original's officialese: "with no emissions that pose a risk to people, animals or plant life".
yarn-deadset.register: Light for level 3: a handful of swaps in a largely untouched release. No swearing.
yarn-deadset.tone: Tone kept whole: "These pilots work with the FAA to make sure flights are safe and in line with U.S. law."
yarn-deadset.flow: Smooth: "Their AS350 choppers will be fitted with a long “stinger” that sticks out from the main cabin".
yarn-deadset.variety: Few terms, each once: "kick off", "push", "pin down", "chunk", "heaps", "choppers".
yarn-deadset.essence: Unmistakably the original: "Flights will be based out of the Bishop and Lone Pine airports".

engine.meaning: The text is the original almost verbatim, so every fact survives: "The survey areas still have significant exploration and production potential."
engine.sense: The one slang term strains: "These scientific instruments are flamin' passive" uses an intensifier of annoyance where the original means "completely".
engine.authenticity: Untranslated apart from "modernise" and "metres", with one bolted-on "flamin'" in otherwise formal release prose: "flamin' passive with no emissions that pose a risk to humans".
engine.register: Far lighter than level 3: essentially the original with a single "flamin'".
engine.tone: The release's tone is kept except where "flamin' passive" jars against a safety assurance.
engine.flow: Reads as the original does, with one jolt: "These scientific instruments are flamin' passive".
engine.variety: One slang term in the whole text: "flamin'".
engine.essence: Unmistakably the original, since it largely is the original: "Low-level plane flights will begin in early October".

yarn-troppo.quote: Okay, so. If you're out in eastern California or a sliver of western Nevada from early October and you hear a chopper buzzing about low over your roof, don't go ringing anyone.
yarn-troppo.original: Low-level airplane flights will begin in early October over eastern California and a sliver of western Nevada
yarn-troppo.why: Stock opener and a framing ("over your roof", "don't go ringing anyone") the release doesn't have.

yarn-troppo.quote: No photos and no video, either, so nobody's perving in your backyard.
yarn-troppo.original: No photography or video data will be collected.
yarn-troppo.why: Flippant gloss on a privacy assurance.

yarn-troppo.quote: Handy thing to know if you live near a volcano, ay?
yarn-troppo.why: One of many asides that push the text well past level 3.

yarn-troppo.quote: the top rock man in California

yarn-dinkum.original: the largest historic producer of tungsten in the U.S.

yarn-deadset.quote: will provide the groundwork geological data

yarn-deadset.quote: The survey includes magnetic and radiometric data collection from helicopters along pre-planned flight lines spaced 660 feet (200 metres) apart
yarn-deadset.original: The survey includes magnetic and radiometric data collection from helicopters along pre-planned flight lines spaced 660 feet (200 meters) apart
yarn-deadset.why: Long stretches left as the original, so the brief's weight is not met.

engine.quote: The survey covers a portion of eastern California on the western edge of the Great Basin, which hosts a diverse range of mineral deposits
engine.original: The survey covers a portion of eastern California on the western edge of the Great Basin, which hosts a diverse range of mineral deposits

summaries.yarn-troppo: Lively and mostly idiomatic, faithful in substance, but told as a full yarn against a level-3 brief.
summaries.unharnessed: Clean, natural and faithful, a little light, but it rewrites a direct quote.
summaries.yarn-dinkum: Natural, faithful and pitched exactly at level 3; the best of the set.
summaries.yarn-deadset: Faithful and natural where it changes anything, but light for level 3.
